question: Does NFRDI's 2025 Lake Naujan inventory provide a waterbody-resolved fish-species list or another usable fish occurrence dataset?

source.title: Preserving Lake Naujan: A call for sustainable management
source.author: Cyrenes Moncawe
source.publisher: National Fisheries Research and Development Institute
source.publication: Fisearch: A Quarterly Publication of the DA-NFRDI, 7(2), 26-27
source.access: Official NFRDI repository metadata and the complete two-page PDF were reviewed. No item-specific license or reuse grant was displayed in the metadata reviewed.

reportedInventory.activity: Community and fishing-operations inventory, not an identified fish-species survey.
reportedInventory.coverage: 17 lakeside barangays across Naujan, Pola, Socorro and Victoria

fishTaxaMentionedAsContext.context: Named as the endemic paitan; the article reports vulnerable IUCN status and describes a historical decline, citing Labatos rather than presenting new species-level survey results.

comparisonWith2026AssessmentSummary.interpretation: These are differently timed and described source activities. Keep their aggregate counts separate; the sources do not explain the differences or provide comparable sampling definitions. Neither article's current summary publishes a fish taxon list by site.

rightsAndUse.decision: Do not extract or publish species/status statements as Bangwit fish records from this newsletter without a separate source and rights review. The operational aggregate counts remain research context only.

limitations: The article gives no species-composition table, specimen vouchers, capture dates, sampling method, taxon-by-site assignments or coordinates.
Fish taxa in the prose are historical/contextual citations or summaries of the distinct 2024 risk assessment, not results of the April-May 2025 barangay inventory.
No item-specific reuse license was found in the repository metadata or reviewed article pages; no structured species data or article text was copied into the app.
The 2025 operational counts and 2026 stock-assessment counts are not reconciled and must not be merged or presented as one time series.

sources.supports: Official repository metadata for author, year, issue, pages, abstract and content type; no item-specific license statement was found in the reviewed metadata.
Full two-page source for the April-May 2025, 17-barangay inventory and reported fishery-operation totals.
Separate July 2025-June 2026 stock-assessment summary, its 43 aquatic taxa aggregate, and 2026 fisher/boat totals; no species list published.

nextAction: Keep the 2025 inventory and 2026 stock-assessment summaries separate. Use the existing unsent inquiry to request the 2025-2026 taxon list, methods, sampling/landing sites, taxon-by-site table, and reuse terms; do not add newsletter taxa to Bangwit occurrence data.
